info.title: Amar Dokan POS API
info.description: RESTful API for Amar Dokan POS, inventory, restaurant management, and multi-store marketplace. Phase 6 adds server-side barcode lookup, bulk inventory actions, inventory movement logs and the owner profile endpoints documented here. Note: this spec documents the most-used routes; the full route list lives in server/routes.ts.

get.description: Returns operational status, database connectivity, and session store availability.

200.description: Active session role and user details

post.summary: Process a sale with transactional stock deduct
Settle a dining table guest order (AmarPay)
Close cashier shift with discrepancy audit
Format-check a bKash / Nagad transaction id (NOT a verification)
post.description: Phase 1 honesty fix: this endpoint never contacts any gateway and verifies nothing. It only checks the transaction-id format. Do not treat its response as proof of payment. See docs/gateway-callback-spec.md.

get.summary: Sync status: database state + server outbox depth
get.description: Owner/staff session required. Same live sources as /health, plus fallback mode.

Platform-admin session required. Live database ping, fallback mode, server outbox depth, last backup-export time, and error-tracking configured/enabled booleans (the DSN itself is never exposed). Backs the Admin Panel 'System Status' tab.

post.summary: Replay the disk outbox into PostgreSQL now
post.description: Platform-admin session required. No-op (with reason) when no database is configured. Live PostgreSQL replay is still UNVERIFIED in staging — see docs/staging.md.

post.summary: Place a marketplace order (server prices, transactional stock deduct)
post.description: Customer session required. Prices are taken from the server's products, never the client's totals; stock is deducted transactionally and restocked on cancellation. Requires a UUID v4 idempotencyKey (the order id).
No session required (QR table link). Requires an idempotencyKey; replaying the same key returns the original order instead of creating a duplicate.

get.summary: Export complete JSON backup of store records

get.description: Per-product forecast from real sales history. Response shows windowDays, leadTimeDays, the rule used, and the visible basis per product: suggested = ceil(avg daily sales over last N days x lead-time days - current stock), minimum 0.
Products with expiry dates, alerted at 30, 14 and 7 days before expiry with severity by nearness (watch/warning/critical/expired).
Products with stock but no sales in the window (default 90 days, configurable) with a discount/clearance suggested action.
Branches of the current store.

post.description: Create a branch. The first branch becomes the default. Requires manage_settings.

get.description: Products scoped to one branch; another branch stock does not leak in.
Sales scoped to one branch.

post.description: Create a counter inside a branch. Requires manage_settings.

get.description: Closed-shift totals grouped per counter: expected cash, actual cash, discrepancy, per counter.
Suppliers with totalDue (money owed).

post.description: Reduces the supplier due and records a supplier_payment expense.

get.description: Sum of money owed to all suppliers of the store; shown on the Due List.
Draft/partial/received/cancelled purchase orders.

post.description: Suggestions become draft orders the owner reviews before anything is ordered. Nothing is ordered by creating a draft.
Receives goods: updates stock, writes inventory-log entries, and raises the supplier due by the received value.
Only a draft can be cancelled.

get.description: Owner-created coupon codes.

post.description: Owner only. Validation happens server-side at sale time; client discounts are never trusted.

get.description: Points per customer phone: 1 point per full 100 taka, 1 point = 1 taka when redeemed, capped by balance and bill server-side.
CSV export that opens in Excel.
CSV export that opens in Excel.
CSV export that opens in Excel.
Combined VAT + profit-by-category + staff-performance CSV; opens in Excel. This is CSV, not a native .xlsx file.
Owner-scoped export. Contains no PIN verifiers.

post.description: Imports reference data only (products, suppliers, coupons, branches, counters). Sales and expenses are counted as skipped and never imported, so money records are never silently overwritten. Response reports counts, imported, skips and errors.

get.summary: Look up one product by printed barcode (own store only)
get.description: Phase 6. Exact match on the product's barcode field, scoped to the caller's store. 404 PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND when no product in this store carries the code.

404.description: No product with that barcode in this store

post.summary: Bulk inventory actions: adjust stock, set price, delete
post.description: Phase 6. Body: { ids (1-500), action: adjust-stock|set-price|delete, delta (adjust-stock, integer), price (set-price, >= 0), confirmed: true (delete only) }. Stock can never go negative; per-product skips are reported as { id, reason } and never hidden.

get.summary: Stock movement history for the caller's store
get.description: Phase 6 surface (route predates Phase 6): every product create/stock change and sale writes a log entry (in/out/adjustment/sale) with reason and actor; the Inventory screen's per-product History panel reads this endpoint and filters by productId.

put.description: Owner only. Accepts storeName, storeCategory, address, phone, zila, upozila, thana, profilePicture, defaultVatRate (0-100) and a new pin (hashed server-side). Phase 6: the Profile screen now displays and edits zila/upozila/thana, which the API already carried but the UI never rendered.

200.description: The updated public user (pin never returned)
